args.stdin:
WITH product_skus AS (
  SELECT pv.product_sku
  FROM product_variants pv
  WHERE pv.brand = 'Milwaukee' AND pv.series = 'Milwaukee Professional M18 5AB-LER' AND pv.model = 'Corded Angle Grinder'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'disc_diameter' AND pvp.property_value_text = '115 mm')
  UNION
  SELECT pv.product_sku
  FROM product_variants pv
  WHERE pv.brand = 'Karcher' AND pv.series = 'Karcher Workshop SC 27T-68S' AND pv.model = 'Cleaning Machine'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'machine_type' AND pvp.property_value_text = 'wet dry vacuum')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'power' AND pvp.property_value_text = '1400 W')
  UNION
  SELECT pv.product_sku
  FROM product_variants pv
  WHERE pv.brand = 'Karcher' AND pv.series = 'Karcher WD SC 1PM-1UM' AND pv.model = 'Cleaning Liquid'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'cleaner_type' AND pvp.property_value_text = 'floor cleaner')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'volume' AND pvp.property_value_text = '500 ml')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'surface' AND pvp.property_value_text = 'glass')
  UNION
  SELECT pv.product_sku
  FROM product_variants pv
  WHERE pv.brand = 'Spax' AND pv.series = 'Spax Outdoor T-Star 1GS-NEI' AND pv.model = 'Wood and Drywall Screw'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'screw_type' AND pvp.property_value_text = 'drywall screw')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'diameter' AND pvp.property_value_text = '6 mm')
  UNION
  SELECT pv.product_sku
  FROM product_variants pv
  WHERE pv.brand = 'Wavin' AND pv.series = 'Wavin Professional Tigris 31G-M1A' AND pv.model = 'Drain Trap and Siphon'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'trap_type' AND pvp.property_value_text = 'bottle trap')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'diameter' AND pvp.property_value_text = '50 mm')
  UNION
  SELECT pv.product_sku
  FROM product_variants pv
  WHERE pv.brand = 'AlcaPlast' AND pv.series = 'AlcaPlast Universal Basic 1CT-04J' AND pv.model = 'Valve and Connector'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'connector_type' AND pvp.property_value_text = 'shower hose')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'diameter' AND pvp.property_value_text = '20 mm')
)
SELECT s.store_id, s.record_path, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ps.product_sku) FROM product_skus ps WHERE ps.product_sku IN (SELECT si.product_sku FROM store_inventory si WHERE si.store_id = s.store_id AND si.available_today_quantity >= 1)) AS cnt
FROM stores s
WHERE s.store_name = 'Ljubljana Center PowerTool'
LIMIT 1;
